ledger.x: c. 1500: the Kingdom of Fazughli is established. Infobox "Established: c. 1500"; "Oral traditions assert its establishment by refugees from the Nubian Kingdom of Alodia". The land is the page's description, not a dated border.
1685: Fazughli ceases as a kingdom and becomes a Funj province whose governors take the title of manjil.

wars.name: Sennar conquest of Fazughli
wars.outcome: The Hameg princelings of Fazughli were subdued by Sennar in 1685 and kept as vassal governors.

certainty.note: Described by the mountain region and the peoples round it.
